item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera is preparing salt water for a science activity at home in Jaipur. She adds spoonfuls of salt to 100 cm³ of water at room temperature, stirring after each spoonful. After a while, she notices that no matter how long she stirs, some salt stays at the bottom of the glass. What has happened to the water?

options.A: The salt has reacted with the water and formed a new substance.
options.B: The water has reached its solubility limit, so extra salt remains undissolved.
options.C: The water has evaporated, leaving the salt behind.
options.D: The salt particles have become too large to dissolve.
